description: USE THIS to verify an IBAN (international bank account number) before relying on it — instead of guessing whether it looks right. Checks the country, the country-specific length, and the ISO 7064 mod-97 checksum, and returns the country, check digits and BBAN. Call this whenever a user supplies a bank account for a payment, payout or invoice.

iban.description: The IBAN to validate; spaces are ignored.

name: validate_iban
